text:
maya: Heads up — ACME (acct acme-corp) says invoice #INV-2026-123 (created 2026-03-16) doesn't contain their PO (PO-9032). This started after a card decline and retry. Billing shows a successful capture (ch_3Jx...) but invoice metadata has no purchase_order field. Customer needs a corrected invoice for POs to pass procurement. Can billing/finance confirm next steps?

james: Can you paste invoice_id and charge id? I'll check whether we can patch the invoice or need to issue a credit+rebill.

maya: invoice_id: inv_01F2ZABC; charge_id: ch_3Jx9Rk; payment created at 2026-03-16T14:02:10Z. Here's the API response snippet from our portal when charging (we log invoice payload):

```
{"id":"inv_01F2ZABC","amount":98000,"metadata":{},"lines":[...],"customer":"cus_acme"}
```

No metadata.purchase_order key.

billing-bot: Automated check: invoice inv_01F2ZABC status=paid, created_by=portal-retry, has_receipt=true, accounting_period=2026-03. Flagging as 'no-po' for manual review.

lia: Finance note: For accounting we can't just patch a paid invoice in our ledger. We typically issue a credit note for the paid invoice and create a new invoice with the correct PO, or - if allowed - a tax-neutral invoice adjustment. Need SSO approval from customer for any retro modifications. What's the customer's requested path?

maya: Customer prefers a corrected invoice (same net amount) rather than a separate credit document. Procurement will only accept a single invoice with PO visible. They're willing to sign an acceptance email. They asked for this today.

tom: On the tech side we can patch visible invoice metadata in the customer-facing PDF/portal without touching ledger IDs: two options - (A) generate a corrected invoice PDF with PO injected and upload as 'replacement_document' while leaving the underlying invoice id unchanged, or (B) create credit note + new invoice and mark linking fields so accounting can offset. Option A is quicker but may break audit trails for some customers. Which does finance prefer?

lia: Finance prefers option B (credit + rebill) to keep ledger clean. If procurement will accept a linked invoice+credit package, that's our default. If customer insists on single document, escalate to Compliance but expect extra approval.

maya: Customer insists single document. I'll get a signed acceptance copy. If compliance allows, we'd prefer option A. Tom, what's the minimal API step we need to generate a replacement PDF? Example request?

tom: We have an internal admin endpoint (PATCH /admin/invoices/{id}/documents) that accepts a replacement PDF. Example (admin key required):

curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/invoices/inv_01F2ZABC/documents" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -F "replacement=@inv_01F2ZABC_with_PO.pdf" \
  -F "reason=Add PO-9032 after customer acceptance"

If compliance forbids altering invoice PDFs for paid invoices we can instead create a credit: POST /invoices -> {type: 'credit_note', linked_invoice: 'inv_01F2ZABC', metadata: {purchase_order: 'PO-9032'}} then create a new invoice. I'll prep both payloads.

james: Please confirm: we need customer-signed acceptance emailed to finance@redwood.ai and a note in the ticket. Once we have that finance will sign off on replacement PDF. Lia to confirm lead time.

lia: If we go replacement PDF route, allow 48 hours for approvals and for accounting to attach the replacement to the month closing. Credit+rebill is faster from an audit standpoint (24 hours).

maya: :thumbsup: I'll request and upload acceptance now. Meanwhile tom, please prepare the admin endpoint call and a credit+rebill payload so we can switch quickly.

billing-bot: Escalation created: ESC-20260316-1996 assigned to lia. SLA: 48h.

tom: Copied here: I queued a candidate credit payload:

```
POST /invoices
{
  "type": "credit_note",
  "amount": 98000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "linked_invoice": "inv_01F2ZABC",
  "metadata": {"purchase_order": "PO-9032", "reissue_reason": "missed_po_after_retry"}
}
```

And new invoice template will use metadata.purchase_order to render PDF.

maya: Uploaded signed acceptance to the support ticket and emailed finance. Ticket: SUP-789112. Customer confirmed they accept credit+rebill if that makes the timeline faster. Moving forward with finance preference.

lia: Received email, looks valid. Approving credit+rebill. James, proceed with credit note creation and new invoice issuance. Tom, mark in logs and make sure PDF renders PO in new invoice.

james: Will create credit and new invoice within next 6 hours. I will post final invoice ids here.

tom: I'll add a quick detection rule to flag 'payment-retry' paths that didn't include purchase_order metadata and surface it in the portal to avoid recurrence.

maya: :white_check_mark: I'll update the customer with ETA.
